evidence.reason: The fixture initializes a repository, sets only local user.name/user.email, and then commits at line 94 without disabling inherited commit.gpgSign. A developer/global configuration with commit.gpgSign=true would make these fixture commits attempt signing; without a usable signing key the commit fails and DeployTests errors during setUp. Setting repository-local commit.gpgSign=false before the baseline commit is a small, compatible isolation fix.
